notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45247916/069cc1fa070352868a8d24d447a03f218b2e7125.png"][/img][/p][p]The update notes for version 1.7.6b are as follows:[/p][p]🌻 Added support for MacOS.[/p][p]🌻 Fixed an issue where the system language would not automatically set correctly for Simplified or Traditional Chinese.[/p]
